request: Autonomously iterate through bounded portfolio risk and turnover research, preserving the existing qualified baseline and every failure.

promotion_contract.primary: Same unchanged rule: excess-return Sharpe strictly above one and CAGR above same-window SPY in both ten/five-year windows under base and stress. Stress must also beat base-cost SPY.
promotion_contract.risk_improvement: Maximum drawdown at most15% in all four primary window/scenario combinations.
promotion_contract.cost_improvement: Both50bp windows pass the primary metrics, also beat base-cost SPY, and each has at least10% less annualized turnover than the unchanged baseline at50bp.
promotion_contract.rule: Primary gates plus no scenario drawdown worsening by more than one percentage point, plus either risk_improvement or cost_improvement.

methodology.data_status: Reuse the exact2026-10-05 endpoint, manifests and original retrieval timestamps. All historical windows were already exposed; later rules are adaptive research, not independent holdouts.
methodology.decision_timing: Only completed month-end observations plus each fresh-account initialization anchor. Base next-open execution and delayed stress are unchanged. No current-day closing information may affect that day's opening trade.
methodology.qld_cap: Cap total fund weight across both sub-portfolios at30%, transferring any reduction to BIL. QLD has embedded daily2x leverage; this is a target limit at decisions, not a continuous intraday guarantee.
methodology.volatility: After the QLD cap, scale all non-BIL weights together until total target variance, including BIL covariance, is at most12% annualized volatility. Estimate covariance from63 fully observed daily returns; move reduced exposure to actual BIL. Never scale upward.
methodology.weight_band: At month end compare the desired full target with actual closing portfolio weights, not the last target. Rebalance only if some weight gap is at least2.5 percentage points. A breached declared risk limit overrides the band. Initial deployment always executes.
methodology.risk_overrides: Risk overrides are evaluated only at the existing monthly decision schedule. Gaps and between-decision drift can exceed target constraints or the15% historical drawdown goal.
methodology.cash_and_units: Same cash-funded fractional-unit accounting and USD1 order charges as the baseline;2% is the target idle-cash reserve, not a continuously enforced cash floor. Integer shares, actual broker spreads and personal taxes are not modeled.
methodology.independent_checks: Replay issued signals through the original simulator and the independent bt cash ledger; recompute metrics from bt equity using ffn and excess returns; verify observed-weight feedback against the replayed positions.
methodology.rolling: For candidates passing the promotion contract, compare every available month-end ten/five-year window on continuous base and stress accounts against the unchanged baseline; disclose all failures rather than change rules.
methodology.trial_accounting: Six new fixed configurations, not a parameter grid. The unchanged baseline is replayed as a control, not counted as a new independent trial. All78 configuration records remain disclosed.
